summary: Implemented the Edge local filesystem artifact store with content-hash naming and deduplication (LOCAL-EDGE-1.5, EDGE-FR-02, ARTF-FR-01). Added the IArtifactStore port in HumanGateway.Core (Core pattern: port in Core, impl in Edge/Relay) with ArtifactHash validation matching the protocol's canonical ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ and an ArtifactHashMismatchException carrying declared+actual hashes. FilesystemArtifactStore stores bytes content-addressed, sharded <root>/<aa>/<bb>/<64-hex>, with dedup via fast-exists + atomic same-volume rename, incremental SHA-256 while streaming, and flush-to-disk before publish so a killed process never leaves a partial artifact at a content-addressed path; concurrent identical writes collapse to one file. Wired into DI in Program.cs via ArtifactStoreOptions (Artifacts:RootPath, default <ContentRoot>/data/artifacts). Added 9 unit tests (naming, round-trip, hex-case normalisation, non-canonical prefix rejection, dedup, 32-way concurrent-save collapse, hash-mismatch leaves no artifact, delete no-op, no leftover temp files).
